observations.statement: Policy-0T performs visible affine recognition and Gaussian consistency before entering recursive search; visible odd-charge Tseitin instances can therefore terminate with zero recursive calls.
Bounded-degree expander-Tseitin formulas separate the full Policy-0T dispatcher from ordinary Resolution: polynomial affine work coexists with exponential clause-Resolution size.
The correct lower-bound object for the existing MAJ3 route is the affine_answer=None Policy-0T search core, not the full affine dispatcher.
A recursive finite translator reconstructed a root Resolution refutation from the verified trace without reading the separately hardwired fifteen-line proof.

The recursive translator emitted ten axiom lines and thirteen Resolution lines, including two reverse unit-reason resolutions and one sibling branch resolution, with maximum width three and proof depth three.
observations.support: experiments/direct/janus_tear_policy0t_recursive_trace_translator.py and the successful C021 certificate workflow.

observations.statement: Residual clause lifting can be implemented without weakening by retaining a root-derived clause for each residual and checking that its restriction equals the trace clause at every local inference.
Implied literals in a terminal conflict can be eliminated finitely by resolving backwards through unit reasons in reverse assignment order until the clause lies inside the entry decision boundary.
The decision-subclause invariant avoids hidden weakening: if a child conflict omits its branch literal it already certifies the parent; otherwise complementary child literals are resolved.
The full Policy-0T dispatcher now requires a mixed Res(⊕) certificate because affine Gaussian reasoning and ordinary clause search have different proof-complexity strength.
C021 creates one terminal shadow and three descendants: the wrong proof system is removed while the exact non-affine route needed by MAJ3 remains live.
